$comment: Traceability: ADR-PROJ023-001 (Hybrid B+C), Phase 5 Red-Blue Composition (Bidirectional Data Flow, Coverage Feedback), Phase 5 Handoff Protocols (IP-5). Data sanitization rules: ATT&CK ID regex ^T\d{4}(\.\d{3})?$, D3FEND ID regex ^D3-[A-Z]{2,5}$. Taint model: Blue-to-Red data is analysis-derived, NOT adversary-modeled.
title: Coverage Feedback Envelope (CFE) v1
description: Cross-skill data contract for blue-team to red-team detection coverage feedback. Reports which ATT&CK techniques now have validated detection rules, enabling red-vuln to adjust vulnerability priority based on detection coverage status. Blue-to-Red direction: analysis-derived content (not adversary-modeled). Source: blue-detect, blue-siem, or blue-monitor. Destination: red-vuln.

engagement_id.description: Identifier of the purple team engagement this feedback relates to. Must match the engagement_id in the originating RBEE envelopes.

from_skill.description: Originating skill. Always /blue-team for CFE envelopes.

to_skill.description: Destination skill. Always /red-team for CFE envelopes.

items.description: Blue-team agent that contributed detection results.

from_agents.description: Blue-team agents that contributed to this coverage feedback. Typically blue-detect, blue-siem, blue-monitor, and/or blue-ioc.

to_agent.description: Red-team agent that receives this feedback for priority adjustment.

coverage_matrix.description: Per-technique coverage status. Each entry covers one ATT&CK technique and its detection rule status across detection domains.

technique_id.description: ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID. Validated against ATT&CK technique ID format.

d3fend_countermeasure.description: D3FEND countermeasure ID mapped to this technique. Validated against D3FEND ID format.

coverage_status.description: Overall detection coverage status for this technique. detected: full detection across all relevant domains. partial: detection in some domains but not all, or detection confidence < 0.70. undetected: no detection rule exists for this technique.

detection_rule_ref.description: File path reference to the primary detection rule for this technique. Relative to work/. Presence indicates coverage_status is 'detected' or 'partial'.

detection_domains.description: Per-domain detection breakdown. Each domain represents a different detection mechanism.

result.description: Log-based detection result (Sigma rules, Hayabusa, Chainsaw).

tier.description: Tool tier for network detection. Tier C indicates rule authored but not execution-validated (Suricata/Zeek/Falco deployment required).

coverage_gap.description: What is missing for full detection coverage. Present when coverage_status is 'partial' or 'undetected'. Used by red-vuln for priority adjustment rationale.
examples: No log-based detection rule for encoded PowerShell download cradle
No detection coverage -- no YARA, Sigma, or Suricata rule for this technique

reason_uncovered.description: Reason code for undetected or partial coverage. Present when coverage_status is 'partial' or 'undetected'.

confidence_tier.description: Overall confidence tier for this coverage feedback. verified: all detection results backed by Tier A tool execution. partial: mix of Tier A/B validated and Tier C methodology-only results. unverified: feedback based on rule authorship only, no execution validation performed.

d3fend_kb_version.description: D3FEND knowledge base version used for technique-to-countermeasure mapping. Required for staleness tracking -- red-lead MUST verify D3FEND version currency before incorporating gaps into future engagement scope. Format: D3FEND version string.

coverage_summary.description: Aggregate coverage statistics for quick orientation without reading per-technique detail.

total_techniques.description: Total number of techniques in the coverage matrix.

detection_rate.description: Ratio of detected+partial techniques to total techniques. Primary termination metric for purple team loop.

full_detection_rate.description: Ratio of techniques with coverage_status = 'detected' only. Stricter metric than detection_rate.

trust_classification.description: Trust boundary classification for this blue-to-red envelope. Analysis-derived (not adversary-modeled): blue-team output is analytical and does not model adversary behavior.

source_skill.description: Originating skill. Always /blue-team for CFE envelopes.

target_skill.description: Destination skill. Always /red-team for CFE envelopes.

source_zone.description: Security zone. Blue-team is universally Zone 1 (Analysis).

taint_level.description: Blue-to-red content is analysis-derived -- it represents analytical findings, not adversary-modeled behavior.

validation_required.description: Validation steps for red-vuln when receiving this envelope.
default: ATT&CK technique IDs validated against known technique catalog
Coverage status reflects actual rule validation results, not aspirational

data_classification.description: Sensitivity classification for this coverage feedback.

tlp.description: Traffic Light Protocol marking. CFE envelopes are typically TLP:GREEN or TLP:AMBER.

contains_credentials.description: Coverage feedback does not contain credential material. Always false for CFE per design.

engagement_scope_id.description: Reference to the governing engagement scope document.

retention_policy.description: How long this envelope should be retained.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this envelope was created.

purple_iteration.description: Purple team loop iteration this feedback relates to.

source_artifact_path.description: Path to the coverage-report.md from which this CFE was constructed.
